title: Codebase Flow Mapper spec
description: The JSON a model writes after reading a repository. codeflow.py render turns it into the HTML page.

repo_name.description: Name of the repository or product.

tagline.description: One sentence a newcomer understands: what this repo does and for whom.

repo_types.description: e.g. backend, frontend, test-automation, infra, data-pipeline, monorepo, library, mobile

start_here.description: Ordered reading list. Every path must exist in the repo.

diagrams.description: Aim for one level 0, one level 1 and one to four level 2 diagrams.

level.description: 0 system context, 1 component map, 2 a flow.

summary.description: Two sentences on what the diagram shows.

mermaid.description: Mermaid source. Quote every label. No code fences. Under about 15 nodes.

legend.description: Optional note on notation, e.g. dashed edges are inferred.

components.description: One row per box in the diagram, mapped to a real path.

open_questions.description: Things you could not determine from what you saw.
